outcome: Cut p95 write latency from 1.4s to 180ms across the ledger.
problem: Settlement writes contended on a single table and blocked reconciliation nightly.
built: An append-only ledger with per-account partitioning and a replay-safe reconciler.

outcome: Backfills went from 9 hours to 22 minutes.
problem: Every ingest reprocessed the full window, so a one-row fix cost a night.
built: Incremental ingestion with watermarking and idempotent upserts.

outcome: One slow consumer no longer stalls the other 40.
problem: A shared retry pool meant a single failing sink backed up every subscriber.
built: Per-consumer retry budgets with dead-letter isolation and replay.

outcome: Dispatchers handle 3x the daily loads with the same headcount.
problem: Dispatch ran on 4 spreadsheets and a phone, with no audit trail.
built: A real-time console with optimistic assignment and a full event log.

outcome: Cut the SOC2 evidence pull from 3 weeks to 2 days.
problem: Evidence lived across 6 systems and was gathered by hand each cycle.
built: A collector that snapshots controls on a schedule and diffs them.

outcome: Search p99 fell below 90ms on a 40M document corpus.
problem: Query latency grew with the corpus and nobody could say why.
built: A rebuilt index with tiered shards and a tracing layer over every query.
